capabilities: create custom highlighter profiles with separate light and dark mode colors, opacity, and corner radius
apply highlights as background fills or underlines via extended ==id= syntax
cycle through active highlighters with a single toggle hotkey
scope highlighters to specific contexts such as paragraphs or headers
manage profiles with reorder, duplicate, and live preview in settings
extras: Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README mentions compatibility with native PDF export and third-party PDF exporter plugins but names none specifically.
intentEvidence: Highlighter Plus extends Obsidian's default highlighting with a powerful, fully customizable system.
problem: Obsidian's built-in highlighting only supports a single default ==mark== style, with no way to define or switch between multiple custom colors or underline styles.
summary: Custom highlighter manager that adds unlimited colored highlight and underline styles with light/dark profiles and hotkey cycling.
